text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Tanabata Sho. On the 
beach near the training camp—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Burn it up! Burn, burn, burn your heart 
upーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*... Are you exploding too, 
Trainer!? Are you burning up with Turbo!?

Twin Turbo threw herself into her training 
with more intensity than ever before.

The ultimate evolution of the "Twin 
Turbo-style front-running." In order to 
achieve that—

If there's any slack in mind or body, it's 
impossible. Unless the Umamusume and 
Trainer become completely as one, it's 
impossible.

"That is precisely why Twin Turbo pushes 
herself to the brink of her heart and 
lungs bursting—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah, I've hit my limit, Trainer!!!!!!!
choice_data_list:
Charge in! That's where you'll break new 
ground!!

Go on, dive right in! That's where you'll 
find a whole new world!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp, cough, gasp*!! *inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Duaaaaaaaah!!!!

From burning out completely— she flared up 
to yet another level.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Something weird happened. When 
Turbo ran all out without thinking about 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I was completely out of breath... And 
then, somehow, I naturally started 
breathing normally again...
choice_data_list: Ah... Looks like you've made it.

text_block_list.text:
Not slowing down deliberately to catch a 
breath, but naturally drawing air after 
running all out to the absolute limit.

On the flat terrain of Fukushima 
Racecourse, maybe I can pull this run off. 
And if I can pull it off—
And then—the day of the event.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hear this, Turbo's rivals!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Today, Turbo's gonna front-run! Run, run, 
run, and keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Total front-runner declaration—!!!!!! If 
you think you can keep up, then just try 
it!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't blame me for whatever happens 
next~~~~~!!!!!
(Ooooohhh!?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eh...? Did you really just go out of your 
way to reveal your hand!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Declaring you'll run as a Front Runner, 
huh... Trainer, what do you think...?

I don't need a way out. Without cutting 
off all escape routes, it'll dull my drive 
to escape in the race.

The "Tanabata Sho." That race wasn't just 
any race. It was the ultimate challenge... 
to see just how true I could stay to 
myself.
